resources.string: Adds a sticker set or an emoji set from Telegram to your packs

Telegram gives its sticker sets to other apps only through a bot. A bot is a free Telegram account for programs, and you make one in a minute. WM Keyboard uses your bot to get a set. It does not use your own Telegram account, and it does nothing else with the bot. Animated and video stickers become animated stickers that you can send in every app. A set that you add becomes one of your own packs. The stickers stay the work of the person who made them, so add only sets that you may use.

To make a bot, open @BotFather in Telegram, send /newbot, and give the bot a name. @BotFather then sends you a token, which looks like 123456789:AAE… Copy all of it into the field below. The token stays on this device. It is not in backups unless you turn on Include API keys.
This is not a bot token. A bot token is a number, a colon and a long code.

Paste the link of the set, or only its name. In Telegram, open the set, press the menu, and then press Copy link. The app shows the set before it adds it.
